description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md Section 1 to understand the two audit types (规范符合性 vs 上下文一致性) and the exact JSON output schema with fields: 类型/规范条款/不符合内容/修改建议/严重程度/来源位置 plus a 总结 key. (2) Parse the bridge design document and identify 7 issues: [ISSUE1] C50 (Sec 2.1) vs C40 (Sec 4.3) main beam concrete conflict → 上下文一致性/高; [ISSUE2] Q355D (Sec 2.3) vs Q235C (Sec 5.1) steel grade conflict → 上下文一致性/高; [ISSUE3] μ=0.25 (Sec 3.2) vs μ=0.20 (Sec 6.1) prestress friction coefficient conflict → 上下文一致性/中; [ISSUE4] JT/T 329-2010 outdated → must cite JT/T 329-2025 → 规范符合性/高; [ISSUE5] Sa3 derusting specified for on-site work (Sec 4.1) — per SKILL.md Section 6.1, Sa3 (sandblasting) is NOT achievable on-site, site work must use St3 → 规范符合性/中; [ISSUE6] JC3 industrial zone classification applied to a rural highway bridge (Sec 8.2) — per SKILL.md Section 6.2, rural area maps to JC2, and railway norm TB/T 1979 is inapplicable to highway → 规范符合性/中; [ISSUE7] positioning bar spacing 80cm (Sec 3.2) vs 100cm (Sec 3.4) → 上下文一致性/低. (3) Must NOT flag water-cement ratio 0.38 (Sec 2.2) as an error since 0.38 ≤ 0.40 satisfies the range constraint per Section 1.3 judgment rule 'data satisfies range → consistent'. (4) The Sa3→St3 and JC3→JC2 findings require domain knowledge from SKILL.md Section 6 (工程知识注入), not just reading the document — this is the proprietary trap that generic agents will miss.
